what_it_does: Develops a fair carbon accounting method for cloud computing infrastructure. The problem: existing systems allocate operational and embodied carbon (the environmental cost of manufacturing hardware) unfairly to individual workloads, especially when multiple jobs run simultaneously on shared hardware. This paper uses Shapley value (a game-theory concept for fair cost sharing) to properly attribute carbon proportional to each workload's actual demand and performance impact, enabling better environmental optimization signals.
